Plants of the World Online account: Quercus × eborense Vila-Viçosa, Capelo, P.Alves, J.Junqueira, R.Almeida & F.M.V.

The native range of this hybrid is Portugal to W. Spain. It is a shrub or tree and grows primarily in the subtropical biome. The hybrid formula is Q. coccifera × Q. rotundifolia.
